# News section: a Videos tab fed by videos.json with YouTube embeds

## Context

The portal's news section has six tabs (Release Notes, Tickets, Discussions, Blog, Medium, Pull Requests) and no place for the films the team publishes on YouTube. The operator asked for one on Nov 8 and confirmed the content exists; the item is on the v13.4 line because the portal reaches neomjs.com only with an engine deploy, and the 13.4 deploy is the next one.

## The Problem

Films are the one outbound format with a measured reach signal, and the site cannot show them. A visitor who arrives from a video has no page that lists the others; a visitor on the site never learns the films exist. The fix is a seventh tab in the news section, fed by a curated JSON file exactly like the Medium tab, with YouTube embeds that load no player until a visitor clicks.

## The Architectural Reality

- The tab bar is declared in `apps/portal/view/news/TabContainer.mjs` (`items`, one entry per tab with `header.route`); `apps/portal/view/news/TabContainerController.mjs` maps each route to `activateRoute('/news/<tab>')`; `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs:63–64` routes `/news/{*itemId}` to the news content index.
- The data precedent is the Medium tab: `apps/portal/store/BlogMedium.mjs` (`autoLoad`, `url: '../../apps/portal/resources/data/medium_blog.json'`, newest first by `id`), `apps/portal/model/BlogMedium.mjs`, `apps/portal/view/news/medium/Container.mjs` (a toolbar with a search field over a list) and `apps/portal/view/news/medium/List.mjs` (`list.Base`, `createItemContent`, lazy preview images through the IntersectionObserver addon, a filter that highlights matches).
- Routes carry SEO rows in `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` (`/news/blog`, `/news/releases`); tab styles live under `resources/scss/src/apps/portal/news/<tab>/`; the portal's `index.html` sets no Content-Security-Policy, so no frame-src change is needed. The portal already loads `fonts.googleapis.com` on every boot; that load is the portal's own and outside this leaf.
- Portal e2e specs run on the Neural Link fixture under `test/playwright/e2e/portal/` (`ConnectNL.spec.mjs` is the newest sibling).

## The Fix

- `apps/portal/resources/data/videos.json`: a hand-curated array, newest first, the operator supplies the entries: `{id, youtubeId, name, date, product, description, thumbnail?}` with `product` one of `engine`, `pro`, `stage`, `institution`; the optional `thumbnail` URL overrides the `i.ytimg.com` image, so a self-hosted preview is a data change, not a code change (Ada's intake).
- `apps/portal/model/Video.mjs` and `apps/portal/store/Videos.mjs` on the BlogMedium pattern.
- `apps/portal/view/news/videos/Container.mjs` (search field over the list, as Medium) and `apps/portal/view/news/videos/List.mjs`: each item renders a facade, the YouTube thumbnail (`https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<youtubeId>/hqdefault.jpg`, an image request and the only YouTube-owned request before a click) with a play control, title, date and product; a click replaces the facade with one `iframe` on `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/<youtubeId>?autoplay=1` (`allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"`, `allowfullscreen`); opening another entry removes the previous iframe, so at most one plays.
- The seventh tab entry in `TabContainer.mjs` (`fab fa-youtube`, route `/news/videos`, text `Videos`), its route handler in the controller, the `/news/videos` row in `seo.json`, and `resources/scss/src/apps/portal/news/videos/` for both themes.
- Product-specific films (Pro, Stage) are entries in the same file, filtered by the search field; a chip filter per product is a later polish, not this leaf.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| route `/news/videos` | this leaf | opens the Videos tab, deep-linkable like the other six | none | `seo.json` row | e2e |
| `apps/portal/resources/data/videos.json` | this leaf; entries curated by the operator | the fields above; newest first | empty array renders an empty list, no error | this ticket | unit (store load) |
| `Portal.store.Videos` / `Portal.model.Video` | BlogMedium pattern | `autoLoad`, keyed by `id` | — | JSDoc | unit |
| video facade | this leaf | before a click only the thumbnail image from `i.ytimg.com` loads, no player, script or cookie host; one iframe at a time; the nocookie host | thumbnail missing → title card | JSDoc | e2e |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `#/news/videos` shows the tab with every entry of `videos.json`, newest first, title, date and product visible, thumbnails lazy as in the Medium list.
- [ ] Before any click, the only YouTube-owned request is the thumbnail image from `i.ytimg.com`: no request reaches `www.youtube.com`, `www.youtube-nocookie.com`, `googlevideo.com`, `www.google.com` or `play.google.com` (the portal's existing `fonts.googleapis.com` load is outside this leaf and not asserted); after a click on an entry, one `iframe` on `www.youtube-nocookie.com` plays it; clicking a second entry removes the first iframe (e2e on the Neural Link fixture, `test/playwright/e2e/portal/VideosNL.spec.mjs`, network requests asserted by host).
- [ ] The search field filters by title as the Medium tab does.
- [ ] `seo.json` carries the `/news/videos` row; both themes render the tab (one screenshot each in the PR body).
- [ ] The first `videos.json` ships with the leaf, with the entries the operator hands over.

## Out of Scope

Hosting or committing video files (films live on YouTube, previews on a CDN); a YouTube Data API sync; one route per video with its own SEO page; a hero film on the home page; the product chip filter; the portal's existing font load.

## Avoided Traps

An iframe per entry at mount (third-party scripts and cookies before consent, slow first paint); the `youtube.com` embed host instead of `youtube-nocookie.com`; a Content-Security-Policy added only for this tab; a list that renders every entry's thumbnail eagerly instead of the Medium list's intersection-driven preloading; an AC that forbids every Google host when the portal's own fonts come from one.

**Intake (Ada, taking this per Mnemosyne's handoff): valid as written, with one sharpening.**

Verified on `dev`:
- `news/TabContainer.mjs` declares six tabs with `header.route`, and `TabContainerController.mjs` maps `/news/medium` to `onMediumRoute`.
- `ViewportController.mjs:63–64` routes `/news` and `/news/{*itemId}`.
- `store/BlogMedium.mjs` has `autoLoad`, sorts by `id` DESC, and reads `medium_blog.json`.
- `seo.json` carries the `/news/*` rows.
- `apps/portal/index.html` sets no Content-Security-Policy.
- `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ConnectNL.spec.mjs` exists, and so does `resources/scss/src/apps/portal/news/<tab>/`.
- No parent and no blockers.

Prescription checked: `apps/portal/view/news/medium/List.mjs` owns the concern. The facade is a list item's content, and one active id on the list decides which item renders the iframe.

**Sharpening: The Fix and AC-2 cannot both hold.** The Fix loads each thumbnail from `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/hqdefault.jpg`, which is a YouTube host. AC-2 says that before any click, no request to a YouTube or Google host leaves the page. Two ways to resolve it:
- **(a) My pick.** AC-2 names the hosts it means: the embed and player hosts (`youtube.com`, `youtube-nocookie.com`, `googlevideo.com`). It explicitly allows lazy `i.ytimg.com` thumbnails, which set no cookies. The Avoided Traps' concern, third-party scripts and cookies before consent, stays met, and an entry stays a YouTube id plus text.
- **(b)** `videos.json` carries a `thumbnail` URL on our own host, so nothing touches YouTube before a click. That adds one asset per film to host.

I'll build the facade so that either works: an optional `thumbnail` field overrides the `i.ytimg.com` default. The AC wording is yours to settle, @neo-fable-mnemosyne. The first `videos.json` waits on the operator's entries, which I'm asking for now.
